notes.title: Roach Killer Update Ver. 1.11:
notes.notes:
Update Ver. 1.11:

1. added the training mode need not all completed, you can also unlock the challenge mode.

2. Fixed some stage instructions.

3. Challenge mode added different weapons.

4. Challenge mode added different enemies.

5. Optimize game content and execution efficiency.
